name: Hypatia's Hoard
purpose: The user's exam-prep bank (Exam Coach) on their PC: subjects, topics and questions with spaced repetition, quizzes and mock exams in chat, answer grading, and a notebook of their own sources with cited answers, study guides, podcast, mind maps and a Socratic tutor. The Exam Coach PWA served by the same app shows and syncs the same data.
notes: HYPATIA_DIR is the Exam Coach repository folder. Keep the app running (python -m hypatia) while the assistant uses it: the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server (starting it if needed) and never opens the database. Build the PWA once with `npm run build:hoard` to use it at {APP_URL}.
